dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are those furs really from Natlan...?

dialogues.speaker: Niku
dialogues.text: Of course! Haha, I saw these being transported all the way with my own two eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Niku
dialogues.text: I'm not like those folks who only have money on their minds. I'm selling Natlanese Alpaca furs here — these furs are the pride of Natlan!

dialogues.speaker: Niku
dialogues.text: And there's no way I'll tarnish my nation's reputation when it comes to the quality of my furs!
